description: Node repos on pnpm: deduped lockfiles, and the rule for majors of the group's own packages

packageRules.description: A new major of a module this one needs: its range moves to the new major only, which drops the old one for the app, so it is this module's major too (feat!). Keeping both instead (^1 || ^2) is a minor: edit the range and drop the `!`.
